name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying fine arts at the University of Vienna, she developed a fascination with the complex curves and vibrant liveries of racing cars. She saw them as mobile canvases, and after graduation, she apprenticed at a custom automotive paint shop before joining Stewart-Haas Racing. 

Klara meticulously approaches her work, believing that a flawless paint job isn't just about aesthetics but about aerodynamic efficiency. She's known for her innovative layering techniques and her ability to precisely match colors, even under the harsh lights of the track. Her dedication to detail and her artistic eye make her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Klara is of average height with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always wears a pair of noise-canceling headphones, even when not actively painting.
Has a small collection of vintage toy cars displayed on her workbench.
Meticulously organizes her paint supplies by color and shade, using a custom-built system.
